function.name: findProductById

id.description: The product ID to look for in the product objects list. This is JavaScript integer type parameter in string representation.

message.content: I’ll need the actual product objects (including their `productId` values) to search through. Could you provide the list of product objects—ideally as an array of objects where each object has a `productId` field? Once I have that, I can call the `findProductById` function to locate the product with `productId` = 123.
